newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong seizes N.Korean arms shipment to Syria.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong seizes N.Korean arms shipment to Syria.

text.p: Hong Kong customs agents said on Saturday they had seized 18 containers of suspected heavy weapons which were being shipped from North Korea to Syria.
The shipment, impounded on September 12, arrived in the British territory from North Korea on August 22 en route to Syria, a customs spokesman told Reuters.
Customs officials opened two containers and found two unassembled howitzer guns inside, he said, adding that they suspected the whole shipment contained field guns.
Government experts are expected to check the other containers on Monday, he said.
The spokesman said no arrests had been made but investigations were continuing. He would not comment on who owned the ship.
The Chinese-language Ming Pao Daily newspaper said the smuggled weapons included howitzer parts and added that the seizure was believed to the largest in Hong Kong's history.

The newspaper quoted sources as saying the seized parts were under heavy guard at one of the territory's eight container ports. They were due to be transferred to a more secure area later on Saturday.
